            (Money(-7, "KWD"), "-0.007 KWD", "-0.007"),
            (Money(123456789012345678901234567890, "USD"), "1234567890123456789012345678.90 USD",
             "1234567890123456789012345678.90"),
            (Money(-1250, "JPY"), "-1250 JPY", "-1250"),

            with self.subTest(text=text):
                self.assertEqual(str(m), text)
                self.assertEqual(m.amount_str(), amount)
